question: Should OpenClaw now make `imsg` 0.11.1 the mandatory iMessage floor and remove the client-side split-send compatibility path for all users?
rationale: This deliberately converts older working installations into a fail-closed upgrade requirement and transfers message-grouping ownership completely to the external CLI; tests cannot decide whether that compatibility tradeoff is now accepted product policy.

options.title: Adopt the new floor
options.body: Accept `imsg` 0.11.1 as the minimum, require doctor migration for stale config, and land after conflicts and current-head live proof are resolved.

options.title: Retain compatibility temporarily
options.body: Keep the existing fallback and configuration until maintainers are ready to require the dependency upgrade across supported installations.

options.title: Narrow the cleanup
options.body: Remove only dead documentation or internal policy while deferring the fail-closed version floor and persisted-config retirement.

recommendation.title: Adopt the new floor
recommendation.body: Accept `imsg` 0.11.1 as the minimum, require doctor migration for stale config, and land after conflicts and current-head live proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans both OpenClaw's iMessage compatibility policy and the upstream `imsg` release contract.
